task.description:
Design and finalize SCH-02 test coverage for timer polling behavior based on the implemented backend changes.

Read SCH-02 acceptance criteria in docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md and the scheduler design before modifying tests.

Ensure coverage includes:
- due timer selection (status=PENDING and fire_at <= NOW())
- per-timer advisory lock behavior (skip when lock unavailable)
- atomic FIRED transition + instance TIMER_FIRED event append
- rollback behavior keeps timers PENDING on failure
- cancellation compatibility (CANCELLED timers are not fired)

Update or add test specs and test files as needed under tests/specs and tests/integration.

Validation requirements:
- zig build exits 0
- zig build test exits 0
acceptance_criteria: SCH-02 acceptance criteria are mapped to explicit test cases
tests/specs/SCH-02.md exists or is updated with traceable cases
Integration test coverage includes advisory lock, atomic firing, and cancellation compatibility

result.summary: Test specs and test code for SCH-02 finalized. Added tests/specs/SCH-02.md with explicit traceability and extended integration coverage in tests/integration/sch02_timer_polling_test.zig with deterministic rollback validation while retaining due selection, advisory lock skip, atomic fire+event append, and cancellation compatibility coverage.
